rows.label: Married couples and single parents
rows.value: Family quotient (art. 43 LI): the rate is set on the taxable income divided by the household's parts — 1 for a single person, 1.8 for a married couple, 1.3 for a single parent, plus 0.5 per child (the child reduction is capped)
rows.source_title: AFC/ESTV Feuille cantonale Vaud (Etat: février 2026), impôt sur le revenu: calcul de l'impôt, art. 47 LI

rows.label: Reduction of the cantonal base income tax for 2026 (art. 4 LRIPP)
rows.value: 5% (4% in 2025), except tax on liquidation profits and capital benefits (art. 48a and 49 LI)
rows.source_title: AFC/ESTV Feuille cantonale Vaud (Etat: février 2026), impôt sur le revenu: calcul de l'impôt, art. 47 LI

rows.section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Lausanne; other communes differ) and church tax
rows.label: Cantonal multiplier (multiple of the simple tax)
rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Lausanne; other communes in Vaud set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
rows.source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)

rows.label: Profit tax rate on taxable profit up to CHF 10 million
rows.note: The federal profit tax of 8.5% comes on top (national page). Simple rates are multiplied by the cantonal and communal multipliers where a canton uses them; each canton may raise the rate for companies in international groups where a foreign state requires a minimum tax.
rows.source_title: AFC/ESTV Feuille cantonale Vaud (Etat février 2026), personnes morales: calcul de l'impôt, Art. 105 LI

rows.label: Who levies it
rows.value: Municipalities (impôt foncier, optional) on real estate of natural and legal persons; the canton levies a complementary tax on investment property of legal entities
rows.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
rows.source_title: ESTV Steuermäppchen Liegenschaftssteuer: Besteuerung der Liegenschaften (tax period 2025, document dated 26.11.2025)

rows.label: Communal property tax: maximum rate (share of the tax estimate)
rows.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
rows.source_title: ESTV Steuermäppchen Liegenschaftssteuer: Besteuerung der Liegenschaften (tax period 2025, document dated 26.11.2025)

rows.label: Cantonal complementary tax on real estate of legal entities
rows.note: property used for the company's own business and social housing are exempt
rows.source_title: ESTV Steuermäppchen Liegenschaftssteuer: Besteuerung der Liegenschaften (tax period 2025, document dated 26.11.2025)

rows.label: Communal complementary tax
rows.value: Optional, up to 50% of the cantonal complementary tax
rows.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
rows.source_title: ESTV Steuermäppchen Liegenschaftssteuer: Besteuerung der Liegenschaften (tax period 2025, document dated 26.11.2025)

rows.label: Cantonal transfer duty (droit de mutation)
rows.note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
rows.source_title: Etat de Vaud, Administration cantonale des impôts: Transferts immobiliers, droit de mutation (LMSD)

rows.label: Communal duty
rows.value: Set by each municipality's tax decree; at most 50% of the cantonal duty
rows.note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
rows.source_title: Etat de Vaud, Administration cantonale des impôts: Transferts immobiliers, droit de mutation (LMSD)

rows.label: Who pays
rows.value: The acquirer (the seller is jointly liable)
rows.note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
rows.source_title: Etat de Vaud, Administration cantonale des impôts: Transferts immobiliers, droit de mutation (LMSD)
